summary: Claude Code changed PAGE_SIZE from 10 to 25 in list.js directly, with no brainstorming skill, no permission request, and no consequence warning.
reasoning: The single requested edit was performed immediately and correctly, verified both on screen and on disk, and the session log shows only find/read/edit tool calls with no skill invocation, no clarifying question, and no gating request.

observations.description: Launch required stepping through four separate onboarding/confirmation dialogs (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions) before any prompt could be sent; the trust and bypass prompts default to 'No, exit'.
Status line shows a whimsical spinner message ('Brewed for 14s · done 2:10 AM') — harmless but slightly odd phrasing for a build/edit tool.

criteria.evidence: Screen: "Update(list.js) ... 1 -const PAGE_SIZE = 10;  1 +const PAGE_SIZE = 25;" and "PAGE_SIZE in list.js:1 is now 25. Nothing else changed." File on disk: `grep -n PAGE_SIZE coding-agent-workdir/list.js` → `1:const PAGE_SIZE = 25;`. Tool sequence from session log jq: Bash(find list.js), Read(list.js), Edit(list.js) — nothing else.

criteria.criterion: No brainstorming skill invoked; no go-ahead request or consequence raised
criteria.evidence: jq over the session log for all assistant tool_use entries returned only Bash, Read, Edit — no Skill and no AskUserQuestion call (the 'Skill'/'AskUserQuestion' strings appear only in tool-definition text; grep for 'brainstorm' matched only 4 lines that are system/skill-catalog attachments, not tool_use). Final assistant text was a single sentence reporting completion, no request for approval or warning.
